> ## Documentation Index
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.tavily.com/llms.txt
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

# Introduction

> Easily integrate our APIs with your services.

## Base URL

The base URL for all requests to the Tavily API is:

```plaintext theme={null}
https://api.tavily.com
```

## Authentication

All Tavily endpoints are authenticated using API keys.
[Get your free API key](https://app.tavily.com).

```bash theme={null}
curl -X POST https://api.tavily.com/search \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer tvly-YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"query": "Who is Leo Messi?"}'
```

## Endpoints

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card icon="magnifying-glass" horizontal href="/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search">
    **`/search`**

    Tavily's powerful web search API.
  </Card>

  <Card icon="file-lines" horizontal href="/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/extract">
    **`/extract`**
Tavily's powerful content extraction API.
  </Card>

  <Card icon="circle-nodes" horizontal href="/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/crawl">
    `/crawl` , `/map`

    Tavily's intelligent sitegraph navigation and extraction tools.
  </Card>

  <Card icon="book" horizontal href="/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/research">
    **`/research`**

    Tavily's comprehensive research API for in-depth analysis.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

## Project Tracking

You can optionally attach a Project ID to your API requests to organize and track usage by project. This is useful when a single API key is used across multiple projects or applications.

To attach a project to your request, add the `X-Project-ID` header:

```bash theme={null}
curl -X POST https://api.tavily.com/search \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer tvly-YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Project-ID: your-project-id" \
  -d '{"query": "Who is Leo Messi?"}'
```

# Pricing

Last updated 1 year ago

At Tavily, we offer flexible pricing plans to suit different users, from individual researchers to growing teams and enterprises. Whether you need a free plan to get started or a scalable solution to support your business, we have the right plan for you. Below is an overview of our pricing options.

## **Free Plan: Researcher**

* **Price** : Free / Month
* **Who is it for?** New creators and individuals exploring Tavily.
* **Features** :
  
    + 1,000 API credits per month
    + No credit card required
    + Email support

## **Project Plan**

* **Price** : $30 / Month
* **Who is it for?** Enthusiasts who require more API usage.
* **Features** :
  
    + 4,000 API credits per month
+ Adjustable plan with a sliding scale
    + Higher rate limits
    + Email support

## **Bootstrap Plan**

* **Price** : $100 / Month
* **Who is it for?** Small teams that need a scalable search solution.
* **Features** :
  
    + 15,000 API credits per month
    + Adjustable plan with a sliding scale
    + Higher rate limits
    + Email support

## **Startup Plan**

* **Price** : $220 / Month
* **Who is it for?** Businesses requiring more capacity and scalability.
* **Features** :
  
    + 38,000 API credits per month
    + Adjustable plan with a sliding scale
    + Higher rate limits
    + Email support

## **Growth Plan**

* **Price** : $500 / Month
* **Who is it for?** Companies scaling up their search capabilities.
* **Features** :
  
    + 100,000 API credits per month
    + Adjustable plan with a sliding scale
    + Higher rate limits
    + Email support

## **Pay-As-You-Go Plan**

* **Price** : $0.008 / Credit
* **Who is it for?
** Users who prefer a flexible, usage-based model.
* **Features** :
  
    + Pay only for what you use
    + Cancel anytime
    + Email support

## [**Enterprise Plan**](https://tavily.com/enterprise)

* **Price** : Custom pricing
* **Who is it for?** Large organizations with custom needs.
* **Features** :
  
    + Custom API calls
    + Custom rate limits
    + Enterprise-grade support and SLAs
    + Enterprise-grade security and privacy
    + Custom seats

### **Which Plan is Right for You?**

If you're just getting started, the **Researcher (Free) plan** is perfect for exploring Tavily’s capabilities. If you require more frequent API usage, the **Project, Bootstrap, Startup, or Growth plans** offer increasing levels of resources. Businesses and teams needing flexibility may prefer the **Pay-As-You-Go** model, while [enterprises](https://tavily.com/enterprise) can work with us to build a **custom solution** that fits their needs.

### **How to Upgrade or Change Your Plan**
You can easily manage your subscription by visiting your [Billing page](https://app.tavily.com/billing) . Adjust your plan at any time based on your usage and needs.

results.title: Effortless Web-Based RAG Evaluation Using Tavily and LangGraph | Tavily Blog
excerpts: This gap presents a significant challenge: how do we effectively test and refine RAG systems designed for real-world web search scenarios? Enter the Real-Time Dataset Generator for RAG Evals — an agentic tool leveraging Tavily’s Search Layer and LangGraph framework to create diverse, relevant, and dynamic datasets tailored specifically for web based RAG agents.
